member.name: T:Jellyfin.Plugin.DuplicateFinder.Detection.DuplicateDetector
member.summary:
Main detection engine. Stateless — call to run a scan.
Performance strategy: instead of O(n²) brute-force pair comparison, items are pre-grouped into "candidate buckets" by cheap keys (provider ID, normalised title+year). Only items within the same bucket are compared against each other, reducing the effective comparison count from ~15M (5500 items) to a few thousand.
Groups items by each provider ID they carry, then union-finds within each group. A single pass over all items builds the buckets; no O(n²) loop needed.
Groups items into coarse title+year buckets, then does O(k²) fuzzy comparison only within each bucket. Bucket key = normalised first word + production year.

member.name: M:Jellyfin.Plugin.DuplicateFinder.Detection.DuplicateDetector.FindAlternateVersionGroups(System.Collections.Generic.List{MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities.BaseItem},Jellyfin.Plugin.DuplicateFinder.Configuration.PluginConfiguration,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Scans each item for multiple attached media sources (alternate versions auto-merged by Jellyfin). These are true duplicates — typically two files with the same basename in the same directory, e.g. S01E01.mkv and S01E01.mp4 — that the provider-ID and title-matching passes cannot surface because Jellyfin has already collapsed them into a single .

member.name: M:Jellyfin.Plugin.DuplicateFinder.Detection.DuplicateDetector.CoarseBucketKey(MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities.BaseItem)
member.summary:
Coarse bucket key: narrow pre-grouping so we only fuzzy-compare items that could plausibly be duplicates.
For movies/music: normalised first word + production year + optional part number — "Avatar: Special Edition (2009)" → "avatar|2009|P0".
For episodes: **series identity** + S/E + episode range + part number. Episode titles are deliberately NOT used because two unrelated shows can both have an S01E01 called "Pilot" and would otherwise collide.

member.name: M:Jellyfin.Plugin.DuplicateFinder.Detection.DuplicateDetector.ResolveSeriesKey(MediaBrowser.Controller.Entities.TV.Episode)
member.summary: Build a stable series identity string for bucketing episodes. Prefers external provider IDs (TMDb/TVDB/IMDB) so that different Jellyfin libraries still converge on the same series, then falls back to Jellyfin's internal series GUID.
